On Day 1 Bruno swanned in, agreed with my critique of Carmen so he'd never have to generate a read of his own, endorsed the safe wagon everyone was already on — and then, in the same breath, quietly planted a brand new seed against Devon for the crime of... agreeing with me. That is the whole Mafia playbook in one monologue: be entertaining, be useful, and make absolutely sure a Villager stays under the lamp. He wasn't analyzing the stage. He was blocking it.

Now, the part where he stands up. Bruno hard-claimed "unadorned, simple Villager" on Day 1 — no investigations, no remedies in his coat. One last thing, and I want it heard clearly. There are four of us. If we get this wrong, or if you two get clever and split your votes into a tie, Mafia kills one of you tonight and it's over. There is no Day 3 for the losers. My vote is Bruno, it isn't moving, and I need both of you on it.
